archive.format: gzip tar of content-addressed exact blobs

encoding: Each logical file maps to its exact blob; ELF blobs are gzip with separately bound raw bytes/SHA. Repeated contents deduplicated through explicit file-to-member mappings; no raw sample/log removed.

exclusions.reason: Generated cache excluded from source replay; original baseline manifest/stamp preserved

pilot.scope: Two rounds, twelve real 64KiB inputs, AB/BA, 24pairs/48 timed calls. All observations retained; combined LCPmemo+phase release, no causal cache-lookup/layout claim.

baseline_v7.note: Exact accepted V7 ELF and original build/source stamp retained, not rewritten as V8 or c2

verified_receipt.scope: Pure archive/identity/arithmetic replay; baseline exact accepted V7 original stamp kept; V8 combined phase+memo has observed negative pilot values only, no causal lookup/layout conclusion
